caption: The drawing features a single spoon depicted in the center of the composition, oriented diagonally with the handle pointing toward the bottom left and the bowl toward the top right. The spoon is rendered in shades of gray, with darker shading used to indicate contours, shadows, and the reflective surface of the metal. The background is a plain, light beige color, with the edges of the main drawing area defined by a rectangular border. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, simple line drawing of the spoon viewed from the side, placed within a separate rectangular box. Near the lower left corner, there is a notation that reads "Scale 2 3/4 = 1.0 in." There is also a small, circular brownish mark in the upper left quadrant of the drawing. The drawing includes faint, handwritten text in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Spoon
